formal_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (A B D Fz : Finset ℕ) (des : ℕ → ℕ), (∀ a b c e : Fin n, G.Adj a b → G.Adj b c → G.Adj c e → G.Adj e a → a = c ∨ b = e) → (∀ T : Finset (Fin n), (∀ i j : Fin n, G.Adj i j → i ∈ T ∨ j ∈ T) → k ≤ T.card) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C → (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = true ↔ ∃ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v ∧ x u = true ∧ x v = true) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[j]? = some g → g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → j ∈ A) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[j]? = some g → g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → (∃ u v : Fin n, u ≠ v ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => decide (i = u)))).getD (n + j) false = true ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => decide (i = v)))).getD (n + j) false = true) → j ∈ B) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[j]? = some g → g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → ¬ (∃ u v : Fin n, u ≠ v ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => decide (i = u)))).getD (n + j) false = true ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => decide (i = v)))).getD (n + j) false = true) → j ∈ D) → (∀ (j1 : ℕ) (g1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[j1]? = some g1 → g1.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ¬ (∀ w1 ∈ g1.inputs, (∃ a1 b1 : Fin n, a1 ≠ b1 ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun i1 : Fin n => decide (i1 = a1)))).getD w1 false = true ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun k1 : Fin n => decide (k1 = b1)))).getD w1 false = true)) → des j1 ∈ g1.inputs ∧ ¬ (∃ a2 b2 : Fin n, a2 ≠ b2 ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun i2 : Fin n => decide (i2 = a2)))).getD (des j1) false = true ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun k2 : Fin n => decide (k2 = b2)))).getD (des j1) false = true)) → (∀ (j6 : ℕ) (g6 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[j6]? = some g6 → g6.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → (∀ w7 ∈ g6.inputs, (∃ a7 b7 : Fin n, a7 ≠ b7 ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun i7 : Fin n => decide (i7 = a7)))).getD w7 false = true ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun k7 : Fin n => decide (k7 = b7)))).getD w7 false = true)) → Relation.ReflTransGen (fun r3 t3 : ℕ => ∃ (j3 : ℕ) (g3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), r3 = n + j3 ∧ C.gates[j3]? = some g3 ∧ ((g3.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ ¬ (∃ a4 b4 : Fin n, a4 ≠ b4 ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun i4 : Fin n => decide (i4 = a4)))).getD r3 false = true ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun k4 : Fin n => decide (k4 = b4)))).getD r3 false = true) ∧ t3 ∈ g3.inputs) ∨ (g3.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ ¬ (∀ w5 ∈ g3.inputs, (∃ a5 b5 : Fin n, a5 ≠ b5 ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun i5 : Fin n => decide (i5 = a5)))).getD w5 false = true ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun k5 : Fin n => decide (k5 = b5)))).getD w5 false = true)) ∧ t3 = des j3))) C.output (n + j6) → (∀ c8 : Fin n, ∃ u8 v8 : Fin n, G.Adj u8 v8 ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun i8 : Fin n => decide (i8 = u8 ∨ i8 = v8)))).getD (n + j6) false = true ∧ c8 ≠ u8 ∧ c8 ≠ v8) → j6 ∈ Fz) → G.edgeSet.ncard + 2 * k ≤ A.card + B.card + 2 * D.card + Fz.card + 2
plain_statement: G with no 4-cycle, E its edges, k at most every vertex cover; C of AND/OR gates on at most two wires, true exactly when some edge has both ends true. A wire is wide if true at two or more one-variable inputs, else thin; an AND is fat if every wire it reads is wide. Pick for each other AND a thin wire it reads; from the output follow thin ORs to their wires and other ANDs to the picked wire. Then AND + wide OR + 2 thin OR + (fat ANDs so reached whose accepted edges no single vertex covers) is at least |E| + 2k - 2. Conjecture.
title: No 4-cycle: fan-in-two AND/OR circuits for the edge function have AND + wide OR + 2 narrow OR + reached fat ANDs at least |E| + 2 tau - 2
